reviews.review: Only playing this game to get the team fortress 2 hat

More part tech demo than game. The achievements might trick you into thinking this is a game with a robust campaign, but it’s short and without much to it. The campaign only takes 2-3 hours to beat from start to finish, I put in over 13 hours, and have a total swarm kill count of 6,623. There’s an achievement for killing 100,000. That suggests it’d take over 200 hours to get that achievement… when the campaign is only 2-3 hours. That’d take me over 50 more runs of the campaign to get that achievement, but there's literally nothing in the game that warrants playing it that much, and so unsurprisingly, there's no one playing. Apparently the code for the game is openly available, so the game is more to show how to make a game integrated with steam’s services and systems… but the resulting game itself is just… so painfully lacking.

Alien Swarm.

The first game that started it, the system that many other games like Left 4 Dead, Back 4 Blood, Payday, Deep Rock Galactic use. Originally a Mod for Unreal Tournament 2004, which was itself probably inspired by the old Sega Arcade hit Alien Syndrome (1987) which was released on nearly everything back in the late 80s.

I like the concept of Alien Swarm, but I would not advise to play it anymore. No good Solo Experience, no 16:9 aspect ration and it uses a really low resolution. Some of the technical aspects you might be able to solve using a ini file, but have fun finding 3 other nut people to play it with.
Overall a really nice callback to ages past for me.
The gameplay is amazing. Very Co-Op and Teamwork. I wish they expanded this game. It is the only game I completed 100% well do to the fact its short LOL
